headline: ISF World Congress at MiCo and Big Buyer opens
taxi: CityLife around congress and fair closing (~18:00); light rain earlier may add demand.
linate: Monday business arrivals plus ISF delegates; steady traffic.

headline: SIMEI opens at Rho as the ISF Congress closes at MiCo
taxi: Rho at fair closing (~18:00); CityLife busy with Big Buyer and ISF departures.
linate: ISF delegates leaving and international SIMEI buyers arriving.

headline: SIMEI at Rho, Big Buyer's last day and World Business Forum opens at MiCo
taxi: Rho at ~18:00 closing; CityLife morning arrivals and ~18:00 exits.
linate: International SIMEI buyers and World Business Forum attendees arriving.

headline: AutoClassica opens at Rho alongside SIMEI; eve of Friday's general strike
taxi: Rho at ~18:00 closing; evening demand as people avoid Friday's strike.
linate: Fair visitors arriving; some travellers moving trips ahead of Friday's strike.

headline: CGIL general strike – metro, bus and tram at risk; Muse at Unipol Dome tonight
taxi: Taxis scarce all day; ATM usually runs until 08:45 and 15:00–18:00; Santa Giulia exits after Muse (~23:00) will be hard.
linate: M4 to Linate at risk outside guaranteed bands – travel early; rail strike from 21:00.

headline: Muse's second night at Unipol Dome, Korn, AutoClassica and a rail strike until 20:00
taxi: Rho at fair close; Santa Giulia and Assago exits around 23:00; rail strike pushes people to taxis.
linate: ENAV air-traffic strike 13:00–17:00 – afternoon delays and cancellations likely.

headline: AC Milan – Frosinone at San Siro, AutoClassica closes, all-day ENAV strike at Malpensa
taxi: San Siro exits ~20:00; Rho at fair close.
linate: Some Malpensa traffic may shift to Linate; check flights.

headline: Quiet Monday after a busy weekend
taxi: Normal weekday demand; no big evening events found.
